basis: CBF6 development A/B resolve only2/32 correct axes and C resolves0/32. Sign2/2 is not orientation robustness; C conditional sign is undefined. The literal-only stock MLM pair interface and declared one-layer adaptation did not earn transfer. Final CBF6 outputs do not select prompts, candidates or hyperparameters here.
hypothesis: A task-pretrained NLI pair encoder supplies semantic relations absent from the tested operational stock interface; generic hypothesis syntax and native pooler may matter separately from encoder weights.
primary_metric: Fresh final joint signed-atom accuracy, with all G0-G7 required before replication; no competitor superiority claim.

stock_xsmall.eligibility: Existing stock baseline only; own literal data is shipping-train

nli_xsmall.eligibility: conditional/review: SNLI share-alike and mixed MNLI provenance; research use only until shipping obligations resolved

excluded_now.ModernBERT_NLI: Declared NC-derived tuning; research-only, do not substitute2048 context with stock8192
excluded_now.mmBERT_NLI: Declared XNLI NC tuning; research-only; downstream training128 is not validated8192
excluded_now.mDeBERTa_NLI: Declared XNLI NC tuning and larger size; not needed for the minimal English screen
excluded_now.Moritz_xsmall_all33: Binary classifier, not three-label; neutral-benchmark overlap

format_rule: Only the fixed generic hypothesis and bare field vary. No descriptions, alias words, field IDs, oracle labels, numeric weights, full compositions or candidates in neural input.

data.training: Byte-identical CBF6 literal training_atoms32; every field pair labeled signed relation or unrelated. No aliases train.
data.validation: Byte-identical CBF6 literal validation_atoms32, whole-text disjoint
data.G0: Byte-identical held literal32, diagnostic only, not optimizer/checkpoint selection
data.development: Only old CBF4/5 aliases32 and compositions50; do not use CBF6 final as development
data.state_and_literal: Byte-identical states64 (32test) and155 exact literal cases
data.new_final: 128 new signed atoms (16 per direction,64 opposite pairs) and128 two-term compositions (64 reversal pairs), no full old CBF4/5/6 phrases or literal schema-name leakage; blind independent meaning audit before training; all atoms used
data.freshness: Persist lexical overlaps versus all old texts, train/validation and source hashes; no post-result filtering
data.licenses: Authored criteria shipping-train; pretrained NLI checkpoints conditional/review; no NC dataset enters training

training.head: One linear width-to3 R head, biases; new random initialization
training.normalizer: Train-only feature mean/std, floor0.01; separate per frozen feature interface
training.checkpoint: Minimum unweighted literal-validation CE, earlier tie; no alias/G0/final checkpoint selection
training.encoder: All parameters frozen and eval; native NLI pooler also frozen; full before/after parameter hashes required

arms.head: Reuse exact CBF6 A checkpoint/features as baseline; no retuning
native classifier, NLI class indices reordered
literal linear
arms.trigger: Only if no eligible xsmall arm passes development

controls: Always complete all six stock/xsmall controls. Stock bare versus higher isolates generic format within stock; stock versus NLI CLS with identical format isolates pretrained checkpoint package (not pretraining algorithm causality); NLI CLS versus native pooler isolates readout; native versus learned R head exposes label-remapping/domain assumptions. Larger width/depth is not an isolated mechanism comparison.

native_mapping.rule: Validate actual config label map and reorder classifier/logits by names, not numeric guess
native_mapping.limitation: Contradiction does not generally imply lower, nor neutral unrelated. This is a falsifiable empirical bridge restricted to authored unconditional monotone one-field preferences; never a universal logical reduction or certificate.

selection: After declared development controls, first eligible all-gate pass in arm order. If none pass, highest development joint atom, then alias decisions, then lower floating parameter count, then earlier order. Stock controls cannot promote. Persist immutable selection BEFORE reading final text/labels. Score exactly ONE selected architecture on final. Final never triggers larger candidate, prompt or interface change.
decoder: Exactly CBF6 decoder: per-field ternary argmax; UNKNOWN if all unrelated; otherwise largest max(lower,higher)-unrelated among nonzero rows, canonical field tie. Persist all four-by-three uncalibrated class masses and resolutions.
compiler: Unchanged schema_grounding_compiler and integer-percent exact state/executor. Only unknown atoms invoke semantic callback; exact weights/operators and literal dispatch unchanged.
statistics: Same64 reversal-pair cluster bootstrap10000seed0 nominal95% descriptive intervals as CBF6. Candidate/swaps dependent; gates point-based screening only. No neutral benchmark superiority inferred.

replication.learned_R_head: Freeze winning model/interface/data/recipe/decoder; retrain head seeds11/13, every seed must pass before capability promotion
replication.native_frozen_classifier: Training seeds do not apply. Require two independently authored, blinded new128-atom/128-composition confirmation pools before promotion; inference repeats/shuffles are not seed replication
replication.shipping: Checkpoint provenance conditional/review blocks shipping release until resolved or reproduced from eligible stock/explicitly licensed data. A research gate pass is not shipping clearance.

failure_branches.axis_low_sign_supported: Training-only schema descriptions/paraphrases and contrastive hard-negative field discrimination under new preregistration
failure_branches.axis_high_sign_low: Explicit comparative/reversal training under new protocol
failure_branches.all_interfaces_fail: Targeted semantic-domain control, then retire literal-only registry grounding assumption and investigate criterion-conditioned Ephemeral Atoms; do not keep random head/capacity tuning
failure_branches.native_only_pass: Treat as empirical narrow function; confirm fresh pools then OOD/many-family transfer, no generic logical claims
